"Holiday $500s" is early in its run, with about three-quarters of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

Everything here about "Holiday $500s" comes from official Georgia lottery numbers, current through November 10.
1916.headline: Where this game is in its run

1917.body:
"50X Merry MONEY" is near the start of its run, with about three-quarters of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

If "50X Merry MONEY" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
1917.headline: How far along this game is

1918.body:
About a quarter of the tickets for "100X Merry MONEY" are sold. The top prize count has held, with three of three still unclaimed. The number of tickets printed is fixed, so that is a plain good sign.

Every line of 100X Merry MONEY's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
1918.headline: No top prize claimed lately

1921.body:
The most common win left on "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" is a free ticket. The second biggest prize left is $10,000, and three of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

If you play "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
